label: Gulf War Illness Induced Sex-Specific Transcriptional Differences Under Stressful Conditions.
summary: Gulf War Illness (GWI) is a multi-symptom disorder affecting 1990-1991 Persian Gulf War veterans and is characterized by post-exertional malaise, neurological symptoms, immune deregulation, and exhaustion. Causation is not understood, and effective diagnostics and therapies have not yet been developed.
